content: miekg/dns v1.1.67: Server struct created inline (no NewServer function). Customize via struct literal with Addr, Net, Handler fields. Call srv.ListenAndServe() to start. Use dns.Client{Timeout: 5s}.Exchange(msg, addr) for synchronous queries. HandlerFunc type is func(ResponseWriter, *Msg). For fake servers in tests, create dns.Server with custom Handler and start on ephemeral port.
